messages:
jen: quick ping on PR #2789 — ran the linter and hit two small style/naming issues blocking the merge. can someone take a quick look? cc @matt @lina
matt: I can grab this in ~20. which files?
jen: pkg/serving/cache.go (exported func name looks wrong) and cmd/runner/main.go (mixed tabs + wrap). linter output snippet:
```
cache.go: exported function RoundtripCache should be RoundTripCache
main.go: mixed tabs/spaces on startup.go:42
```
jen: not a hard blocker for the RC if we need to defer, but nice to merge beforehand.
lina: I can handle the cache.go rename. I'll add a small compatibility shim (old name -> new name) so external callers don't break.
sam: quick q — are we ok to run `gofmt -w` across the repo in this PR? CI will flag format otherwise.
jen: yes, gofmt is fine. please keep the shim and add a deprecation comment.
matt: pushed `fix/pr-2789-style` branch with main.go formatting + import tidy (`gofmt` + `gci`). CI started.
ci-bot: CI: linux-amd64 tests failing: TestKVCacheCollision (flaky). re-run queued.
matt: re-run completed — linux-amd64 passed. @alex can you do a quick approval on the shim approach? not sure if we want a migration note.
alex: looks fine to me. add a one-line entry to CHANGES.md under compatibility noting the alias.
lina: will add CHANGES.md note and update PR description before merge.
jen: perfect — if CI stays green, merge after approvals. thanks all :rocket:
